fluff.overview: The Capellan Confederation has always relied on its infantry to compensate for the CCAF's chronic shortage of heavier assets. Conventional foot soldiers, drawn from the citizens' militia system that defines Capellan military service, form the backbone of garrison forces across the Confederation's commonalities. Mechanized tracked platoons give Capellan commanders infantry that can keep pace with armored formations across rough terrain. The tracked transports provide better cross-country mobility than wheeled vehicles, allowing these platoons to operate alongside the tanks and combat vehicles that form the CCAF's armored reserve. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these platoons field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs. TAG spotter sections within the platoon carry target acquisition gear that can designate targets for semi-active homing munitions, enabling precision strikes from artillery, aerospace, or missile-equipped units operating beyond visual range.
